column1: # Everyday words chosen for message typing (greetings, family, travel, meals, questions, verbs, time, weather,
# feelings, numbers, places). The choice of words is editorial (an AI proposal); a word only reaches the
# keyboard lists when tools/make_vocab.py finds it in an external source (see docs/keyboard-sources.md).
# Variety-specific forms are not listed here: they live in variant-pairs.tsv with their reference.
# tier: 1 = very common in messages, 2 = common, 3 = useful. The tier sets a minimum weight (REVIEW.md).
